environment: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production environment atlas for an original browser pixel fantasy RPG, Lexicon Quest. Generate ONE precisely aligned atlas, 2 columns by 4 rows, eight equal panels, no gutters, no frames, no labels, no text. Whole image portrait 2048x2304; each panel is a wide 16:9 scene (1024x576). Detailed modern pixel-art RPG diorama aesthetic, visible crisp pixel clusters, limited elegant color palettes, dramatic lighting, painterly depth but distinctly pixelated. Original art, not existing game characters. Each scene must fill its panel edge to edge. Upper-left: Willowmere, a cozy medieval village under ancient willows, lantern-lit cobblestone bridge and distant grand archive at blue hour, teal foliage and warm amber windows. Upper-right: Nameless Hollow, ruined mirror palace with fragmented reflective towers, silver-blue mist, violet dusk. Row 2 left: Emberpeak, immense mountain forge, brass workshops, lava channels, orange fire against indigo smoke. Row 2 right: Valewyn, flooded royal keep, arches and crowned statue reflected in luminous turquoise water, moonlit gold trim. Row 3 left: Whispering Desert, ancient sandstone observatory among dunes, star-filled purple sky, celestial rings and golden lamps. Row 3 right: Skybound Isles, floating islands with a small fantasy airship and bridges over sunlit clouds, sky blue and peach light. Row 4 left: Hollow North, frozen cathedral and pine forest, cold aurora and snow, luminous icy pale blue. Row 4 right: First Library, colossal impossibly tall library, books and glyphs circling a central luminous open book, violet void and warm golden light. Composition: usable foreground in lower third in every panel, monumental landmarks middle distance, atmospheric layered background. No UI, no letters, no people close-up, no watermark. Exact clean 2x4 grid is essential for CSS background slicing.
